domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators are unlike.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions so the denominators match before subtraction.
Tag in mixed-number subtraction when only the fractional parts require denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators already match and no equivalent-fraction conversion is performed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d unless the step's purpose is denominator matching through equivalent-fraction conversion.
Do not tag normalization of a nonstandard mixed number such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as a whole plus zero fractional part or a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d to support mixed-number or fraction-part subtraction.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a step explicitly separates or identifies whole and fractional parts to prepare for partwise subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion between fractions.
Do not tag the actual subtraction of whole parts or fractional parts once the operands are already prepared.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping after subtraction reveals an insufficient fractional part.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract whole-number and fractional parts separately once the operands are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts are subtracted in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when fraction parts are subtracted after denominators are already matched or after normalization.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding an LCD or converting to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps.
Do not tag simplification or final recombination alone.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted into d/d and added to the fractional part.
Tag when regrouping is used in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction to resolve a negative or insufficient fractional difference.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d before any regrouping occurs.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms or rewrite a zero-valued fraction as 0 or an integer when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.
Tag when a result such as 0/d is rewritten as 0.
Tag when the final numeric form is changed from a non-simplified fraction to a simpler equivalent value.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a lowest-terms result with no explicit simplification.
Do not tag combining whole and fractional parts unless simplification also occurs in that same step.
Do not tag normalization or denominator matching.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number part and fractional part into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fractional results are recombined into one mixed number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when a zero fractional part is absorbed into an integer final answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure subtraction steps before recombination.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly recombines parts for the final form.
Do not tag single-fraction problems that end immediately after subtraction unless a separate final-form step is shown.
